# Share email

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/emails/:id/share`

Create a link anyone can open to see the email and its delivery timeline, without signing in. DELETE /emails/:id/share revokes every link for the email.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `share_email`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The email id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expires_in_hours` | number | No | How long the link works, 1 to 720. Default: `24`. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/emails/4ef9a417/share' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "expires_in_hours": 72
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "email_share",
  "email_id": "4ef9a417-…",
  "url": "https://delivrie.io/share/8c1f…",
  "expires_at": "2026-12-01T09:12:04Z"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Forward email

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/emails/:id/forward`

Forward a sent or received email to other addresses, with an optional note above it.

Access: Sending or full access. MCP tool: `forward_email`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The email id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` | string \| string[] | Yes | Where to forward it. |
| `from` | string | Yes | Sender on a verified domain. |
| `note` | string | No | A message shown above the forwarded email. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/emails/4ef9a417/forward' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "to": "ops@acme.com",
    "from": "Acme <support@mail.acme.com>",
    "note": "Can you look at this?"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "id": "9b2e…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Send event

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/events`

Record a custom event for a contact. Live automations listening for the event start a run right away. The contact is created if it doesn’t exist.

Access: Any API key.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | string | Yes | Lowercase name with dots for namespaces, like user.created. |
| `email` | string | Yes | The contact the event is about. |
| `data` | object | No | Any JSON up to 32 KB. Use it in automation filters, conditions and templates as {{{data.field}}}. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/events' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "event": "user.created",
    "email": "ada@example.com",
    "data": {
      "country": "NG",
      "plan": "free"
    }
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "event",
  "id": "8d1c…",
  "event": "user.created",
  "runs": 1
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 422 | `validation_error` | The event name or email is invalid, or data is over 32 KB. |

# List events

`GET https://delivrie.io/api/events`

Without name: every event name your team has sent, with when it was first and last seen. With name: the most recent events with that name.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `list_events`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Query parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | An event name, like user.created. |
| `limit` | number | No | Results, 1 to 100. Default: `50`. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://delivrie.io/api/events' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "name": "user.created",
      "first_seen_at": "2026-11-01T09:00:00Z",
      "last_seen_at": "2026-11-14T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Create automation

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/automations`

Create a straight-line automation: a trigger and up to 30 send and wait steps. Build branches and conditions in the dashboard.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_automation`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Name. |
| `trigger` | object | Yes | { "event": "user.created" } or { "segment_id": "…" }. |
| `steps` | object[] | Yes | { "type": "send", "template_id": "alias" } or { "type": "wait", "amount": 2, "unit": "days" }. Units: minutes, hours, days, weeks. |
| `reentry` | string | No | once or always. Default: `once`. |
| `publish` | boolean | No | Publish right away. Default: `false`. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/automations' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "Welcome series",
    "trigger": {
      "event": "user.created"
    },
    "steps": [
      {
        "type": "send",
        "template_id": "welcome"
      },
      {
        "type": "wait",
        "amount": 2,
        "unit": "days"
      },
      {
        "type": "send",
        "template_id": "tips"
      }
    ],
    "publish": true
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "automation",
  "id": "au_3…",
  "status": "live",
  "url": "https://delivrie.io/automations/au_3…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Duplicate automation

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/automations/:id/duplicate`

Copy an automation, with its trigger and steps, as a new draft. PATCH /automations/:id renames it (name, reentry) and DELETE /automations/:id deletes one.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `duplicate_automation`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The automation id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | Name for the copy. Default: `Copy of …`. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/automations/4ef9a417/duplicate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "automation",
  "id": "a_9…",
  "name": "Copy of Welcome series",
  "status": "draft",
  "url": "https://delivrie.io/automations/a_9…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# List inboxes

`GET https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes`

Inboxes on your receiving domains, with open, unread and needs-reply counts and each inbox's agent settings.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `list_inboxes`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "inbox",
      "id": "be19…",
      "name": "Support",
      "address": "support@in.acme.com",
      "agent": {
        "enabled": true,
        "tone": "friendly",
        "actions": [
          "draft_reply",
          "add_labels",
          "mark_spam"
        ],
        "forward_to": []
      },
      "counts": {
        "open": 12,
        "unread": 3,
        "needs_reply": 5
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Create inbox

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes`

Create an inbox for an address on a receiving domain. Mail to that address lands in it. On a domain that only accepts specific addresses, the address is added to the list.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_inbox`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | string | Yes | An address on a receiving domain, e.g. support@in.acme.com. |
| `name` | string | No | Display name. Defaults to the address's local part. |
| `description` | string | No | What the inbox is for. |
| `agent` | object | No | Agent settings (see Update inbox). |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "address": "support@in.acme.com",
    "name": "Support"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "inbox",
  "id": "be19…",
  "name": "Support",
  "address": "support@in.acme.com",
  "agent": {
    "enabled": false
  }
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 422 | `validation_error` | The address isn't on a domain with receiving turned on, or already has an inbox. |


---

# Update inbox

`PATCH https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes/:id`

Rename an inbox or set up its agent. The agent runs on new mail and acts only within the actions you allow. It drafts replies for people to send and never sends them itself, and it forwards only to the addresses in forward_to.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `update_inbox`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The inbox's id or address. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | Display name. |
| `description` | string | No | Description. |
| `agent.enabled` | boolean | No | Run the agent on new mail. |
| `agent.instructions` | string | No | Plain-language instructions, up to 4,000 characters. |
| `agent.tone` | string | No | friendly, professional, concise, or your own words. Default: `friendly`. |
| `agent.actions` | string[] | No | Any of draft_reply, add_labels, archive, mark_spam, assign, add_note, forward. |
| `agent.forward_to` | string[] | No | Up to 5 addresses the agent may forward to. Required for forward. |
| `agent.signature` | string | No | Added to the agent's drafts. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X PATCH 'https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes/4ef9a417' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "agent": {
      "enabled": true,
      "instructions": "We sell Acme Projects. Refunds within 30 days. Billing questions go to Sam.",
      "actions": [
        "draft_reply",
        "add_labels",
        "mark_spam",
        "assign"
      ]
    }
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "inbox",
  "id": "be19…",
  "name": "Support",
  "agent": {
    "enabled": true,
    "tone": "friendly",
    "actions": [
      "draft_reply",
      "add_labels",
      "mark_spam",
      "assign"
    ],
    "forward_to": [],
    "signature": ""
  }
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Delete inbox

`DELETE https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes/:id`

Remove an inbox and its agent settings. Mail to the address keeps arriving, and its conversations move to Other mail.

Access: Needs a full access key..

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The inbox's id or address. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X DELETE 'https://delivrie.io/api/inboxes/4ef9a417' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "inbox",
  "id": "be19…",
  "deleted": true
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# List threads

`GET https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/threads`

Conversations from received email, newest first. q takes Gmail-style search: words, "phrases", from: to: subject: label: is:unread|read|assigned|unassigned|needs-reply in:archive|spam|trash|anywhere has:attachment|draft before: after:.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `list_inbox_threads`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Query parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inbox` | string | No | An inbox's id or address, or none for mail outside any inbox. |
| `status` | string | No | open, archived, spam, trash or all. Default: `open`. |
| `needs_reply` | boolean | No | Only threads whose latest message is from the contact. |
| `unread` | boolean | No | Only unread threads. |
| `assignee` | string | No | me, a team member's email, or none. |
| `label` | string | No | Only threads with this label. |
| `q` | string | No | Search, using the syntax above. |
| `limit` | number | No | Results, 1 to 100. Default: `20`. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/threads' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "inbox_thread",
      "id": "th_4…",
      "inbox_id": "be19…",
      "mailbox": "support@in.acme.com",
      "contact": "ada@example.com",
      "subject": "Refund",
      "snippet": "Hi, I'd like…",
      "unread": true,
      "status": "open",
      "needs_reply": true,
      "labels": [
        "billing"
      ],
      "assignee": {
        "email": "sam@acme.com",
        "name": "Sam"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

`GET https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/threads/:id`

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

## Path parameters

```json
  "object": "inbox_thread",
  "id": "th_4…",
  "subject": "Refund",
  "messages": [
    {
      "id": "a5c3…",
      "direction": "inbound",
      "from": "ada@example.com",
      "text": "Hi, I'd like a refund…",
      "created_at": "2026-11-14T10:22:30Z"
    }
  ],
  "notes": [

      "id": "n1…",

      "author": {
        "name": "Sam"
      }
    }
  ],
```

# Reply to thread

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/threads/:id/reply`

Reply in the thread. Threading headers and the Re: subject are set for you.

Access: Sending or full access. MCP tool: `reply_to_thread`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The thread id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | No | Plain-text reply, wrapped in simple HTML for you. Provide text or html. |
| `html` | string | No | HTML reply. |
| `from` | string | No | Sender. Defaults to the thread's address. |
| `cc` | string[] | No | Cc recipients. |
| `draft_id` | string | No | Marks this draft as sent. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/threads/4ef9a417/reply' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "text": "Thanks Ada, your refund is on its way."
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "email",
  "id": "7d1f…",
  "thread_id": "th_4…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Update thread

`PATCH https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/threads/:id`

Move a thread between folders, mark it read or unread, assign it, or set its labels.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `update_thread`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The thread id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | No | open, archived, spam or trash. |
| `unread` | boolean | No | Read state. |
| `assignee` | string \| null | No | A team member's email, me, or null to unassign. |
| `labels` | string[] | No | Label names. Replaces the thread's labels; new labels are created. |

## Example request

```bash
    "refunds"
```
```json
  ]
}
```

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |

| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Create draft

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/drafts`

Save a draft for the team: a reply in a thread (thread_id), or a new email from an inbox. Nothing is sent.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_draft`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thread_id` | string | No | Reply in this thread. Recipient, subject and sender default from the thread. |
| `inbox` | string | No | Or start a new email from this inbox (id or address). |
| `to` | string[] | No | Recipients. |
| `cc` | string[] | No | Cc. |
| `bcc` | string[] | No | Bcc. |
| `subject` | string | No | Subject. |
| `text` | string | No | Body as plain text. |
| `html` | string | No | Body as HTML. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/inbox/drafts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "thread_id": "th_4…",
    "text": "Hi Ada, your refund is on its way."
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "inbox_draft",
  "id": "dr2…",
  "thread_id": "th_4…",
  "status": "draft"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Create domain

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/domains`

Add a sending domain. The response includes the DNS records to add at your DNS provider.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_domain`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | The domain or subdomain, for example mail.acme.com. |
| `region` | string | No | Sending region. Default: `eu-west-1`. |
| `return_path` | string | No | Subdomain used for bounces and SPF. Default: `send`. |
| `click_tracking` | boolean | No | Rewrite links to track clicks. Default: `false`. |
| `open_tracking` | boolean | No | Add a tracking pixel. Default: `false`. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/domains' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "mail.acme.com",
    "region": "eu-west-1"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "domain",
  "id": "d91e…",
  "name": "mail.acme.com",
  "status": "pending",
  "records": [
    {
      "record": "DKIM",
      "type": "TXT",
      "name": "delivrie._domainkey.mail",
      "status": "pending"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 403 | `plan_limit_reached` | Your plan's domain limit is reached. |
| 422 | `validation_error` | The domain name isn't valid or is already added. |


---

# Set up DNS on Cloudflare

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/domains/:id/cloudflare`

Add the domain's DNS records to its Cloudflare zone using your Cloudflare API token (Zone: Read and DNS: Edit). The token is used for this request only and never stored. Existing records are never changed or deleted.

Access: Needs a full access key..

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The domain id. |
| `api_token` | string | Yes | A Cloudflare API token with Zone: Read and DNS: Edit on this domain's zone. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/domains/4ef9a417/cloudflare' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "domain",
  "id": "d91e…",
  "status": "pending",
  "cloudflare": {
    "zone": "acme.com",
    "created": [
      {
        "type": "TXT",
        "name": "delivrie._domainkey.acme.com"
      }
    ],
    "existing": [],
    "skipped": []
  }
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Update domain

`PATCH https://delivrie.io/api/domains/:id`

Change tracking, TLS, the return path or receiving settings.

Access: Needs a full access key..

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The domain id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `click_tracking` | boolean | No | Track link clicks. |
| `open_tracking` | boolean | No | Track opens. |
| `tls` | string | No | opportunistic or enforced. |
| `return_path` | string | No | Bounce subdomain label. |
| `receiving_enabled` | boolean | No | Receive email on this domain. |
| `receiving_subdomain` | string | No | Receive on a subdomain, like in. Empty for the domain itself. |
| `receiving_mode` | string | No | all or specific. |
| `receiving_addresses` | string[] | No | Addresses that accept mail when receiving_mode is specific. |
| `receiving_forward_to` | string[] | No | Up to 5 addresses that get a copy of every received email, like a Gmail inbox. An empty list turns forwarding off. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X PATCH 'https://delivrie.io/api/domains/4ef9a417' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "open_tracking": true
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "domain",
  "id": "d91e…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Create API key

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/api-keys`

Create a key. The token is returned once, so store it somewhere safe.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `name` | string | Yes | A name to recognise the key. |
| `permission` | string | No | full_access or sending_access. Default: `full_access`. |
| `domain_id` | string | No | Limit a sending key to one domain. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/api-keys' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "Production",
    "permission": "sending_access"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
  "id": "k_31…",
  "token": "dlv_••••••••"
```

# List audit log entries

`GET https://delivrie.io/api/audit-logs`

Who changed what in the team, newest first. Enterprise plan; other plans get 403 plan_required.

Access: Needs a full access key..

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number | No | 1 to 200, default 50. |
| `before` | string | No | An entry id: returns older entries. |
| `action` | string | No | Only actions starting with this, e.g. domain. or billing.plan_changed. |
| `actor` | string | No | Only entries by this user id or API key id. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://delivrie.io/api/audit-logs' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "has_more": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "audit_log",
      "id": "1842",
      "created_at": "2026-11-23T14:02:11.000Z",
      "actor_type": "user",
      "actor_label": "ada@acme.com",
      "action": "api_key.created",
      "target_type": "api_key",
      "target_label": "Production",
      "metadata": {
        "permission": "sending"
      },
      "ip": "102.89.34.10"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Rename API key

`PATCH https://delivrie.io/api/api-keys/:id`

Rename an API key. Its token, access and domain don't change.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `update_api_key`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The API key id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | The new name, up to 100 characters. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X PATCH 'https://delivrie.io/api/api-keys/4ef9a417' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "Production (web)"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "api_key",
  "id": "k_3…",
  "name": "Production (web)",
  "prefix": "dlv_8xQ2",
  "permission": "sending"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Create webhook

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/webhooks`

Send events to an HTTPS endpoint. Each payload is signed; failed deliveries are retried with backoff.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_webhook`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | string | Yes | An https:// URL. |
| `events` | string[] | Yes | Events to send, for example email.delivered and email.bounced. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/webhooks' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "endpoint": "https://acme.com/hooks/delivrie",
    "events": [
      "email.delivered",
      "email.bounced",
      "email.complained"
    ]
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "webhook",
  "id": "w_8c…",
  "signing_secret": "whsec_••••"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 403 | `plan_limit_reached` | Your plan's webhook limit is reached. |


---

# Create contact

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/contacts`

Create a contact, or update it if the email already exists. Only the fields you send change; properties are merged.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_contact`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | Yes | Contact email. |
| `first_name` | string | No | First name. |
| `last_name` | string | No | Last name. |
| `properties` | object | No | Custom properties. |
| `segments` | string[] | No | Segment ids to add the contact to. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/contacts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "email": "ada@example.com",
    "first_name": "Ada",
    "properties": {
      "plan": "pro"
    }
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "contact",
  "id": "c_12…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Import contacts

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/contacts/imports`

Import up to 50,000 contacts from CSV text or a list. The import runs in the background: check it with GET /contacts/imports/:id (or list them with GET /contacts/imports), or listen for contact.import.completed. Columns other than email, first_name, last_name and unsubscribed become contact properties.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `import_contacts`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `csv` | string | No | CSV text with a header row and an email column. Provide csv or contacts. |
| `contacts` | object[] | No | { email, first_name, last_name, unsubscribed, properties } objects, or plain emails. |
| `columns` | object | No | Maps CSV headers to fields, e.g. { "E-mail": "email", "Company": "property:company", "Notes": null }. |
| `segment_ids` | string[] | No | Add every imported contact to these segments. |
| `update_existing` | boolean | No | Update names and properties of contacts that already exist. false leaves them as they are. Default: `true`. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/contacts/imports' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "csv": "email,first_name,company\nada@example.com,Ada,Analytical Engines",
    "segment_ids": [
      "s_1…"
    ]
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "contact_import",
  "id": "i_4…",
  "status": "queued",
  "total": 1,
  "processed": 0,
  "created": 0,
  "updated": 0,
  "skipped": 0
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://delivrie.io/api/segments/4ef9a417/contacts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "total": 1200,
  "has_more": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "contact",
      "id": "c_1…",
      "email": "ada@example.com",
      "first_name": "Ada"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Remove from segment

`DELETE https://delivrie.io/api/segments/:id/contacts`

Take contacts out of a segment. The contacts aren't deleted. DELETE /segments/:id/contacts/:email_or_id removes one.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `remove_contacts_from_segment`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The segment id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contacts` | string[] | Yes | Emails or contact ids. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X DELETE 'https://delivrie.io/api/segments/4ef9a417/contacts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "contacts": [
      "ada@example.com"
    ]
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "segment",
  "id": "s_1…",
  "removed": 1
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Create broadcast

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/broadcasts`

Create a broadcast draft. Nothing sends until you call Send broadcast.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_broadcast`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | Yes | Sender on a verified domain. |
| `subject` | string | Yes | Subject line. |
| `segment_id` | string | Yes | Who receives it. |
| `html` | string | No | HTML body. Include an unsubscribe link with {{{unsubscribe_url}}}. |
| `topic_id` | string | No | Topic people can opt out of. |
| `name` | string | No | Internal name. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/broadcasts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "from": "Acme <news@acme.com>",
    "subject": "March at Acme",
    "segment_id": "s_4…",
    "html": "<p>Hi {{{first_name|there}}}</p>"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "broadcast",
  "id": "b_7…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Send broadcast

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/broadcasts/:id/send`

Send now, or schedule with scheduled_at.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `send_broadcast`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The broadcast id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scheduled_at` | string | No | ISO 8601 date to schedule. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/broadcasts/4ef9a417/send' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "scheduled_at": "2026-11-20T08:00:00Z"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "broadcast",
  "id": "b_7…",
  "status": "scheduled",
  "recipients": 3240
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# List recipients

`GET https://delivrie.io/api/broadcasts/:id/recipients`

Who a broadcast went to, with each email's status and whether it was delivered, opened, clicked, bounced or unsubscribed. Before sending, the contacts it will reach. `recipients` is the count after unsubscribes, topic opt-outs and suppressions.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `list_broadcast_recipients`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The broadcast id. |
| `limit` | number | No | Results per page, 1 to 100. Default: `50`. |
| `offset` | number | No | How many results to skip. Default: `0`. |
| `status` | string | No | Only emails with this status, e.g. bounced or delivered. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://delivrie.io/api/broadcasts/4ef9a417/recipients' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "recipients": 1180,
  "has_more": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "broadcast_recipient",
      "email_id": "4ef9…",
      "email": "ada@example.com",
      "status": "delivered",
      "delivered": true,
      "opened": true,
      "clicked": false,
      "bounced": false,
      "unsubscribed": false
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Create template

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/templates`

Create a template. Publish it before sending it from the API.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `create_template`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Template name. |
| `alias` | string | No | Stable name to send by, like order-confirmation. |
| `subject` | string | No | Subject with {{{variables}}}. |
| `html` | string | No | HTML body. |
| `from` | string | No | Default sender. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/templates' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "Order confirmation",
    "alias": "order-confirmation",
    "subject": "Order {{{order_id}}} confirmed",
    "html": "<p>Hi {{{first_name}}}</p>"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "template",
  "id": "t_2…"
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Update template

`PATCH https://delivrie.io/api/templates/:id`

Change a template's name, alias, from, reply_to, subject, variables, html or content. Changes are saved as a draft: emails keep using the published version until you publish again. :id can be the alias.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `update_template`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The template id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | Template name. |
| `subject` | string | No | Subject, with {{variables}}. |
| `html` | string | No | Replaces the content with this HTML. |
| `variables` | object[] | No | { name, type, fallback } definitions. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X PATCH 'https://delivrie.io/api/templates/4ef9a417' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "subject": "Welcome to Acme, {{first_name}}"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "template",
  "id": "t_2…",
  "status": "published",
  "note": "Saved. Publish the template to use these changes when sending."
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |


---

# Draft email with AI

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/ai/draft`

Write an email in the team's brand voice from a web page, a brief, or both. Returns subject, preview text and editor blocks. With target, writes it straight into a template or draft broadcast, and anyone with it open sees it arrive.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `ai_draft_email`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | No | A page to write from: a blog post, changelog, product or event page. |
| `brief` | string | No | What the email is for. Provide url, brief or both. |
| `kind` | string | No | broadcast or template. Default: `broadcast`. |
| `length` | string | No | short, medium or long. Default: `medium`. |
| `tone` | string | No | A tone for this email, on top of the brand voice. |
| `variables` | string[] | No | Variables the email may use, like first_name. |
| `target` | object | No | { type: "template" \| "broadcast", id } to write into. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/ai/draft' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "url": "https://acme.com/blog/new-dashboard",
    "brief": "Announce it to customers",
    "length": "short"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "ai_draft",
  "subject": "The new dashboard is here",
  "preview_text": "Twice as fast, live today",
  "content": {
    "blocks": [
      {
        "id": "k2x9a1b",
        "type": "title",
        "html": "Meet the new dashboard"
      }
    ]
  },
  "notes": "Check the pricing link.",
  "source": {
    "url": "https://acme.com/blog/new-dashboard",
    "title": "Introducing the new dashboard"
  }
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Rewrite blocks

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/ai/rewrite`

Rewrite blocks with an instruction, in the brand voice. Ids, variables, links and styles are kept unless the instruction changes them. POST /ai/subjects with { text } suggests subject lines.

Access: Needs a full access key..

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blocks` | object[] | Yes | The blocks to rewrite. |
| `instruction` | string | Yes | How, e.g. "shorter" or "add a line about the free trial". |
| `kind` | string | No | broadcast or template. |
| `context` | string | No | The rest of the email as text, for context. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/ai/rewrite' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "blocks": [
      {
        "id": "b2",
        "type": "text",
        "html": "We are very excited to announce our brand new dashboard."
      }
    ],
    "instruction": "Shorter and plainer"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "ai_rewrite",
  "blocks": [
    {
      "id": "b2",
      "type": "text",
      "html": "The new dashboard is here."
    }
  ]
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Edit email content

`POST https://delivrie.io/api/templates/:id/content`

Edit a template (or, at /broadcasts/:id/content, a draft broadcast) block by block. Anyone with it open in the editor sees the change within seconds and can undo it. Template changes stay a draft until published.

Access: Needs a full access key.. MCP tool: `edit_email_content`.

## Headers

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | string | Yes | Bearer dlv_your_key |

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | The template id. |

## Body

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ops` | object[] | No | Operations, in order: replace, update, insert, delete, move. See the AI writing guide. |
| `blocks` | object[] | No | Replace every block. |
| `subject` | string | No | New subject. |
| `preview_text` | string | No | New preview text (broadcasts). |
| `summary` | string | No | One line on what changed, shown in the editor. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://delivrie.io/api/templates/4ef9a417/content' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "ops": [
      {
        "op": "update",
        "id": "b2",
        "set": {
          "html": "Thanks for joining, {{first_name}}."
        }
      },
      {
        "op": "insert",
        "after": "b2",
        "block": {
          "type": "button",
          "text": "Open the dashboard",
          "href": "https://acme.com/app"
        }
      }
    ],
    "summary": "Added a button"
  }'
```

## Response

```json
{
  "object": "template_content",
  "id": "t_2…",
  "agent_edit": {
    "by": "Claude",
    "at": "2026-11-28T10:00:00Z",
    "rev": 3,
    "summary": "Added a button"
  }
}
```

## Errors

| Status | Name | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | `missing_api_key` | No Authorization header was sent. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Nothing with that id on this team. |

# Delivrie MCP server

Connect AI assistants to Delivrie with the remote MCP server at `https://delivrie.io/api/mcp` (streamable HTTP).
Clients that support OAuth open a Delivrie page where you pick the team and approve scopes (`send`, `read`, `manage`); revoke access under Settings → Connected apps.
Clients without OAuth can send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer dlv_your_key`.

## Install

### Claude (Claude Code, Desktop & claude.ai)

Remote · OAuth. terminal:

```bash
# Claude Code: opens a Delivrie page to approve access
claude mcp add --transport http delivrie https://delivrie.io/api/mcp

# Claude Desktop & claude.ai: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector
# URL https://delivrie.io/api/mcp
```

### Cursor (Agent mode & Composer)

Remote · OAuth. ~/.cursor/mcp.json:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "delivrie": { "url": "https://delivrie.io/api/mcp" }
  }
}
```

### Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI & IDE)

Local bridge. ~/.codex/config.toml:

```toml
[mcp_servers.delivrie]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://delivrie.io/api/mcp"]
# mcp-remote opens the Delivrie approval page on first run
```

### v0 (v0 by Vercel)

Remote · API key. v0 → Settings → MCP connections:

```text
# Add a custom MCP connection
Name     Delivrie
URL      https://delivrie.io/api/mcp
Header   Authorization: Bearer dlv_live_••••
```

### Antigravity (Google Antigravity agents)

Remote · OAuth. Settings → Customizations → Open MCP Config, then Refresh and Authenticate:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "delivrie": { "serverUrl": "https://delivrie.io/api/mcp" }
  }
}
```

### VS Code (GitHub Copilot agent mode)

Remote · OAuth. terminal:

```bash
code --add-mcp '{"name":"delivrie","type":"http","url":"https://delivrie.io/api/mcp"}'
```

| --- | --- | --- |
| `send_email` | Send one email from a verified domain | send |
